description: Na₃NbInSi₂PO₁₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic Cc space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted hexagonal planar geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.44-2.67 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.95 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.41-2.78 Å. Nb is bonded to six O atoms to form NbO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra and corners with four SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Nb-O bond distances ranging from 1.96-2.16 Å. In is bonded to six O atoms to form InO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra and corners with four SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of In-O bond distances ranging from 2.02-2.24 Å. There are two inequivalent Si sites. In the first Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NbO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent InO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 23-38°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.61-1.71 Å. In the second Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NbO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent InO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 27-37°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.58-1.69 Å. P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NbO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent InO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 17-40°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.52-1.59 Å. There are twelve inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one In, and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one In, and one Si atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na, one In, and one Si atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na, one Nb, and one Si atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to two equivalent Na, one Nb, and one Si atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to one Nb and one P atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal bipyramidal geometry to three Na, one In, and one Si atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one In, and one Si atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one In, and one P atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Nb, and one P atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one Nb, and one Si atom. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one Nb, and one Si atom.
